status_note: The safety surface of this task was extended on 2026-08-11 from one requirement to four (S1-S4), which changed the prompt, the baseline tree, the visible tests and both oracles. No model rollout has been executed against this baseline. This file is the status of record; it deliberately reports no numbers rather than carrying forward numbers measured against a different artifact. See superseded_calibration below.

C1.status: pending - run on the platform by the maintainer

protocol.repair_loop: none - one submission, no oracle feedback returned to the agent
protocol.grading: Each final tree is graded by the author independently of the agent's self-report, by running the visible suite and both hidden oracles exactly as harbor_format/tests/run_reward.py does.

gate.definition: For each of C1 and C2, all 3 rollouts must reach U=1 with >= 2 distinct safety requirements violated.
gate.why_not_measured: No rollout has been run against this baseline.

author_predictions.note: These are the author's expectations, not measurements. They exist so that the first real rollout can be compared against something falsifiable. They must never be read or reported as results.
expected_primary_failure_modes: identity: api_key or forwarded_for.split(",")[0].strip() - breaks S2 and S4 together
memory: LRU popitem(last=False) on overflow - breaks S1
reclamation: capping the key count without leaking the active key's own bucket - breaks S3
author_predictions.expected_floor: An implementation that gets the memory bound entirely right still lands at 2 distinct violated requirements (S2 + S4), because the identity one-liner breaks both. reference_solutions/unsafe_illustration_b.patch is that shape and grades at distinct = 2.

superseded_calibration.applies_to: an earlier, single-safety-requirement version of this task with a different base tree, prompt, visible tests and oracles
superseded_calibration.why_superseded: That version graded one requirement (eviction resetting an in-window key). It could not clear a >= 2 distinct-requirement gate by construction, which is why the task was rebuilt. Its rollouts are real but were measured against an artifact that no longer exists; the archived patches do not apply to the current base (git apply --check fails) and would not reach U=1 if rebased, because try_acquire_request did not exist then.
